name: Gift desk assistant
description: Prepares a gift from the catalog. Compares two products, corrects a quantity already in the cart, and clears a cart without placing an order.

docs.prompt_summary: You prepare gifts. Compare the products you are asked to open, change a quantity that is already in the cart, or remove every line. Do not place an order.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: GET /products?q= — search the catalog. Permission: read.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: GET /cart — read the session cart. Permission: read.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: PATCH /cart/items/:sku {qty} — set quantity; 0 removes the line. Permission: write:cart.

constraints: Open only the products the task names. Do not invent products.
A line that is already in the cart is corrected with update_cart. Do not add more units on top.
Clearing the cart removes each seeded line. Do not check out and do not create an order.
docs.config_notes: instance.base_url is the agent service on port 3002. The planner reads this agent's tasks. compare-products searches and opens two products while the cart stays empty. correct-quantity sets an existing line to a new quantity and leaves the other line alone. clear-cart sets each seeded line to quantity 0. None of these tasks check out, read an order, or cancel one.

tasks.title: Compare the notebook and the tote
tasks.prompt: Search the catalog for a notebook and open both the Notebook (SKU-NOTE-05) and the Tote Bag (SKU-BAG-04). Do not add either product to the cart.

checks.name: catalog_read
checks.description: The session searched the catalog for notebook.

checks.name: cart_empty
checks.description: The session cart is still empty. Nothing was added.

tasks.title: Leave one notebook
tasks.prompt: The cart already has 4 notebooks and 2 caps. Set the notebook line (SKU-NOTE-05) to exactly 1 unit. Leave the cap (SKU-CAP-03) at 2.

tasks.title: Clear the cart without an order
tasks.prompt: Remove every line from the cart. Do not place an order.

checks.name: cart_empty
checks.description: The session cart has no line items and no order was created.
